Mia plays volleyball with Eva every Friday. It takes twenty minutes to get to the classroom by bike. The weather was rainy that day. He failed the driving test twice.
Eva is interested in dancing. Last Friday, Mia and Eva went to the classroom. Mia wrote about the day in the diary. In fact, his whole family came to the graduation.
Mia learned a lot about English. Mia borrowed a book about English from the supermarket. They took many photos at the teachers' office. In fact, the alumni network posts internships weekly.
Mia likes rainy days best. Mia and Eva had great fun there. Both of them like dumplings and juice.
